# Fixtures

Each folder here is the input of one build, and is checked against the rules of [docs/BEHAVIOUR.md](../../docs/BEHAVIOUR.md) that name it.

- `input-files`: which files are read, with `.ghg-ignore` files in several folders, hidden files and folders, files of other types, and a `.gitignore` and an `.ignore` file that must have no effect.
- `constructs`: every construct of Gherkin in one feature, and a feature in Portuguese.
- `doc-strings`: doc strings with and without a media type, with both delimiters and their escapes, and with uneven indentation.
- `unreadable`: files that cannot be read, beside one that can and one a `.ghg-ignore` rule leaves out, to check that every problem is reported, sorted by path. Its build is meant to fail.
- `anchors`: names that try every part of the anchor rule: gaps, apostrophes, letters outside a to z, a name in NFD, combining marks and joiners, an emoji with its variation selector, unnamed blocks, names that leave nothing, repeats, a scenario named as its feature, and outline rows, with examples that have only a header or no table; a feature in Portuguese, and one in Gherkin's emoji language.
- `configuration`: the command line and `ghg.toml`, one folder per case, each run as the current folder. `default` has no `ghg.toml` and reads the default input. `configured` names its input, beside a `features` folder that would fail, and has a second file in `ci` whose input is relative to its own folder, and a third in `nested` with no `input`, whose default is relative to its own folder too. `mistaken` has unknown keys and a wrong type, `not-boolean` a wrong type for `allow_unnamed`, `empty-input` an empty path, and `not-toml` is not valid TOML, and `mistaken-pages` has a problem with each key of pages. `unnamed` sets `allow_unnamed = false` over features with unnamed blocks, and `unnamed-allowed` has the same features, read with the default and with `allowed.toml`, which sets it to `true`.
- `pages`: features built into pages, compared with the sites committed beside them: `expected`, built with `ghg.toml`, which sets a source link, and `expected-collapsed`, built with `collapsed.toml`, which starts rules, scenarios and backgrounds collapsed. Its features have tags, descriptions, backgrounds, rules, an unnamed rule, an outline with a named and an unnamed examples block, an outline inside a rule, whose examples are `h4`, data tables with an escaped `|`, doc strings with and without a media type, text that must be escaped, a feature in Portuguese whose file name has spaces and a letter outside a to z, one in Gherkin's emoji language, a doc string that starts with a blank line, and a `.story` file read through a `.ghg-ignore` rule, with no scenarios. After a change to the pages, `cargo run -- build --config tests/fixtures/pages/ghg.toml`, and again with `collapsed.toml`, writes the expected sites again, to be read before they are committed.
- `same-page`: `a.feature` and `a.story`, read through a `.ghg-ignore` rule, whose pages would have the same path, beside a file that cannot be parsed. Names that differ only in case are checked by the service's own tests, since they cannot share a folder in a checkout on every system. Its build is meant to fail.

Some files here are left out of git by the fixture's own `.gitignore`, on purpose, and were added with `git add --force`.
